title: T118 (Tinyana) PNC - Saying Torah Without Forethought — HaShem Himself Reviews Four Times
hebrewTitle: אמירת תורה — "אז ראה ויספרה, הכינה וגם חקרה" — ארבע פעמים אצל הקב"ה
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Le-inyan chiddushei Torah she-yeish gedoilim she-hayu meshabchim osam, she-oimrim Torah bli machshavah ve-iyun mi-koidem — amar she-ein zeh ma'alah kol kach.** Some praise the gedoilim who *say Torah without prior machshavah and iyun* — *Rabbeinu said this is not such a ma'alah*. **Ki be-vadai yecholin lomar Torah bli machshavah ve-iyun, ki yecholin le-kasheir ha-machshavah ve-ha-dibbur le-HaShem yisbarach ve-lomar Torah bli machshavah ve-iyun mi-koidem — aval toiv yoser k'she-choshvin Torah.** *Yes*, one can say Torah without prior preparation if the *machshavah ve-dibbur are bound to HaShem* in real-time. *Aval toiv yoser k'she-choshvin Torah*. **Ha-loi afilu etzel HaShem yisbarach** — *we find in the Midrash* (Bereishis Rabbah, parshas Ki Sisa, parshah 40): *HaShem yisbarach, k'she-rotzeh le-gallois Torah, hu choizrah arba pe'amim koidem she-oimrah*. **"Az ra'ah va-yesaprah, hechinah ve-gam chakrah"** — *four bechinois: "ra'ah, va-yesaprah, hechinah, chakrah"* — *HaShem yisbarach roeh, soifer, meichin, ve-choiker divrei ha-Torah arba pe'amim koidem she-megalleh osah*. **Kal va-chomer ben adam**, *she-tzarich lachshov ve-le-ayein ve-lachakor u-le-vareir divrei Torah be-machshavto techilah hetev, koidem she-oimrah*.

intermediate.en: **Pesak Rabbeinu**: lomar Torah bli iyun = efshar (m'kashrim machshavah u-dibbur la-Shem), *aval toiv yoter k'she-choshvin Torah*. **Re'ayah mi-Midrash** (ב"ר פ' כי תשא מ): HaShem **"חוזרה ארבע פעמים קודם שאומרה"** — מ-**איוב כח:כז "אָז רָאָה וַיְסַפְּרָהּ, הֱכִינָהּ וְגַם חֲקָרָהּ"** = ra'ah / va-yesaprah / hechinah / chakrah. **K"v ben adam** — lachshov, le-ayein, lachakor u-le-vareir koidem amirah.

scholarly.he: [T2:118א] לומר תורה בלי מחשבה מקודם — לא מעלה כל כך. ב"ר מ' (כי תשא) על איוב כח:כז: הקב"ה חוזר ד' פעמים — "ראה, ויספרה, הכינה, וחקרה." ק"ו לאדם.

beginner.en: **Ve-amar she-achshav be-nakeil me'oid le-chadeish be-Torah, mei-chamas she-kvar nis-pashtu chiburim kedoishim harbeih mi-tzaddikim she-be-doirosaynu.** *Now* — Rabbeinu said — *it is very easy to be mechadeish in Torah*, *because so many holy sefarim of tzaddikim of our generations have spread*. **Ve-kfi ha-sichois ve-ha-his-gallus she-nis-pasht be-yameinu, be-nakeil me'oid le-chadeish be-Torah.** *Like a man drinking at a spring that already has a thousand pipes drawing from it* — *be-nakeil le-chadeish*. **Gam amar al mah she-muva ba-Zoihar ha-Kadoish**: "pasach Rebbi Yitzchok ve-amar..." — *pasach Rebbi Yitzchok* — *k'she-hayah rak poseiach es piv, teikef u-miyad hayah omeir u-megalleh Torah*. *The pasach was the gilui*. **Ve-af-al-pi-chein kvar mevu'ar** — *toiv yoter le-ayein ve-lachshov ("trachtin") Torah*. *Even when you can say Torah from a mouth-opening — even so, lakshov is still better.*

intermediate.en: **Achshav be-nakeil le-chadeish be-Torah** — *mei-chamas pirsum chiburim kedoishim shel tzaddikei ha-doiroth*. **Re'ayah me-ha-Zoihar**: *"pasach R' Yitzchok ve-amar"* — *po-seach piv, teikef oimer*. *Af-al-pi-chein kvar mevu'ar: toiv yoter le-ayein ve-lachshov ("trachtin") Torah*.

scholarly.he: [T2:118ב] בנקל לחדש מחמת התפשטות ספרי הצדיקים. "פתח רבי יצחק ואמר" — מיד; אעפ"כ עדיף לטראכטין (לעיין) קודם האמירה.
